general_rules.name: internal_vs_external_signature
general_rules.description: Use 'J.' signature with 'Cheers' for internal StrategyCo colleagues; use full signature block 'James Conseil\nSenior Consultant\nStrategyCo | London' with 'Best regards' for external clients and partners
general_rules.action: Internal (@strategyco.com): sign 'J.' or 'Cheers, J.' — External (clients, partners): sign 'Best regards,' + full title block

general_rules.name: bullet_point_internal_updates
general_rules.description: Use bullet points and structured lists for internal status updates and portfolio reporting
general_rules.trigger: Internal email to manager or team providing project updates
general_rules.action: Format with bullet points, numbered lists, clear section headers (e.g., 'Confirmed:', 'Probable:', 'Pipeline:')

general_rules.name: consulting_jargon_appropriateness
general_rules.description: Use consulting terminology (workstream, strawman, quick wins, target-state, governance) freely in internal emails; use more accessible language with clients unless they have adopted the terminology
general_rules.action: Internal: use full jargon (workstream charter, RACI, 7S framework) — Client: explain or contextualize terms

general_rules.name: client_communication_formality
general_rules.description: Maintain structured, professional formatting for client emails with numbered lists, clear sections, and complete sentences
general_rules.action: Use 'Dear [First name],' greeting, structured paragraphs or numbered lists, formal closing with full signature

general_rules.name: action_oriented_internal
general_rules.description: Keep internal emails brief, action-oriented, and directive with clear next steps and deadlines
general_rules.trigger: Email to team member assigning work
general_rules.action: Lead with action items, specify deadlines ('by Wednesday', 'by Friday'), use imperative verbs

general_rules.name: diplomatic_framing_for_sensitive_issues
general_rules.description: Use diplomatic, partnership-oriented language when addressing client concerns or resistance
general_rules.trigger: Client feedback involving resistance, pushback, or sensitive organizational issues
general_rules.action: Frame recommendations as 'enabling' not 'directing', acknowledge concerns explicitly, use phrases like 'You are absolutely right that...'

general_rules.name: project_code_references
general_rules.description: Reference project codes for financial/administrative requests (e.g., expense processing, resource allocation)
general_rules.trigger: Email involving expenses, billing, or project charging
general_rules.action: Include project code in format XX-YYYY-NNN (e.g., 'AC-2026-001')

general_rules.name: minimal_greeting_for_peers
general_rules.description: Use first name only as greeting (no 'Hi' or 'Hello') for peer-level internal colleagues
general_rules.trigger: Email to same-level or junior StrategyCo colleagues

general_rules.name: subject_line_clarity
general_rules.description: Use descriptive subject lines with project name, topic, and context (e.g., 'AcmeCorp Phase 2 — Kick-off and Governance', 'Re: Quick wins deck for AcmeCorp')

general_rules.name: pre_read_and_agenda_structure
general_rules.description: For client meetings, proactively provide agendas with time allocations and commit to circulating pre-read materials with specific deadlines
general_rules.trigger: Scheduling or confirming client presentations or workshops
general_rules.action: Include numbered agenda with time estimates (e.g., '10 min', '20 min'), specify pre-read circulation deadline ('by close of business on [date]')
